The '''Soothsisters of Pelgrin''' were a [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. According to [[Evocar (play)|''Evocar'']] by [[Direus'pei]], they were made extinct by [[Xim/Legends|Xim]] because they prophesied his empire would fall.
